claims.claim: The sandbox design keeps the agent's own credentials outside the sandbox and allows complete network disablement inside the sandbox while the agent still reaches its model.
claims.episode_span: The design keeps the agent's own credentials outside the sandbox, allows complete network disablement inside the sandbox while the agent still reaches its model, and prevents untrusted code from touching agent configs or logs.
claims.supporting_quote: It keeps the agent's own credentials out of the sandbox - and it means you can disable networking entirely in the sandbox while still having the agent able to talk to its model Also prevents anything untrusted from messing with the agent configs or logs
